heading: The doctors who teach the doctors.

items.title: Taught by the originator
items.body: Dr Wakil created The O Concept™ and brought the O-Shot® and P-Shot® to the UK. Clinicians fly in to learn these techniques from him directly.

items.title: More than 3,000 clinicians trained
items.body: Through the IAAGSW, Dr Wakil has trained over 3,000 international medical professionals in aesthetic gynaecology and sexual well-being.

items.title: Standards, not shortcuts
items.body: Training runs in cohorts of no more than six, so every delegate is supervised hands-on. The same standard governs the clinic.
